amendment_reason_required.name: amendment_reason_required
amendment_reason_required.value: "note_versions"."previous_version_id" IS NULL OR ("note_versions"."amendment_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length("note_versions"."amendment_reason") >= 10)

signed_note_has_signature.name: signed_note_has_signature
signed_note_has_signature.value: "note_versions"."status" = 'draft' OR ("note_versions"."signed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "note_versions"."signed_by" IS NOT NULL)

issued_requires_safety.name: issued_requires_safety
issued_requires_safety.value: "prescriptions"."status" <> 'issued' OR ("prescriptions"."issued_at" IS NOT NULL AND "prescriptions"."safety_checked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "prescriptions"."safety_source" IS NOT NULL AND "prescriptions"."safety_source" <> 'synthetic-fixture' AND ("prescriptions"."safety_status" = 'clear' OR ("prescriptions"."safety_status" = 'warning' AND "prescriptions"."override_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length("prescriptions"."override_reason") >= 20)))

emergency_requires_reason_expiry.name: emergency_requires_reason_expiry
emergency_requires_reason_expiry.value: NOT "care_relationships"."emergency" OR ("care_relationships"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND length("care_relationships"."reason") >= 20 AND "care_relationships"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

patient_link_role.name: patient_link_role
patient_link_role.value: ("users"."role" = 'patient' AND "users"."patient_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("users"."role" <> 'patient' AND "users"."patient_id" IS NULL)
